description.content:
Read all flow runs that have an SLA violation event within the given horizon.

Args:
    sla_ids (list[UUID]): The IDs of the SLAs to read flow runs for.
    since (datetime): The date to read flow runs since.
    workspace_id (UUID, optional): The ID of the workspace to read flow runs for. Defaults to Path(...).
    account_id (UUID, optional): The ID of the account to read flow runs for. Defaults to Path(...).
    client (AsyncClient, optional): The ClickHouse client to use. Defaults to Depends(clickhouse_client).

Returns:
    Sequence[str]: _description_
